state.ee.description: Observed absolute end-effector poses from RobotState.pose: left then right, each [x,y,z,qx,qy,qz,qw]. action.qpos_valid.description: Per-frame validity mask for action.qpos, ordered ['signal']. 1 means the corresponding source action group is present and finite; Cartesian quaternion groups must also have non-zero norm. Invalid groups are stored as finite zero placeholders with mask value 0. Embodiment: franka_3rgb. OriginData: derived from HDF5 master/joint_position.

state.qpos.description: Source-native joint/effector positions, ordered left arm + left effector + right arm + right effector for bimanual robots; no unit conversion or normalization. Source: states.left_joint.position, states.left_gripper.position, states.right_joint.position, states.right_gripper.position.

state.ee.description: End-effector pose in robot frame, source position units preserved; normalized xyzw quaternion. Missing/invalid poses are zero-filled; consult validity mask. Source: states.left_ee_to_robot_pose, states.right_ee_to_robot_pose.

state.ee_valid.description: Pose validity; 0 marks missing or invalid source pose. Source: .

action.qpos.description: Source-native joint/effector positions, ordered left arm + left effector + right arm + right effector for bimanual robots; no unit conversion or normalization. Source: actions.left_joint.position, actions.left_gripper.position, actions.right_joint.position, actions.right_gripper.position.

action.qpos_valid.description: Per-arm finite action target validity; invalid arms are zero-filled. Source: .

action.ee.description: End-effector pose in robot frame, source position units preserved; normalized xyzw quaternion. Missing/invalid poses are zero-filled; consult validity mask. Source: actions.left_ee_to_robot_pose, actions.right_ee_to_robot_pose.

action.ee_valid.description: Pose validity; 0 marks missing or invalid source pose. Source: .

state/joint/position.left.description: Left-arm absolute joint-position measurements in radians. Embodiment: A2D dexhand. OriginData: proprio_stats.h5::state/joint/position + state/effector/position.

state/left_effector/position.description: Left effector. Six dexterous-hand joint-position measurements in radians. Embodiment: A2D dexhand. OriginData: proprio_stats.h5::state/joint/position + state/effector/position.

state/joint/position.right.description: Right-arm absolute joint-position measurements in radians. Embodiment: A2D dexhand. OriginData: proprio_stats.h5::state/joint/position + state/effector/position.

state/right_effector/position.description: Right effector. Six dexterous-hand joint-position measurements in radians. Embodiment: A2D dexhand. OriginData: proprio_stats.h5::state/joint/position + state/effector/position.

state.qpos.description: Observed absolute configuration ordered as left arm 7, left effector (six dexterous-hand joints per side), right arm 7, right effector. Embodiment: A2D dexhand. OriginData: proprio_stats.h5::state/joint/position + state/effector/position.

state/end/arm_position.description: Absolute left/right flange xyz measurements in meters. Embodiment: A2D dexhand. OriginData: proprio_stats.h5::state/end/position + state/end/orientation.

state/end/arm_orientation.description: Absolute left/right flange quaternion measurements in normalized xyzw order. Embodiment: A2D dexhand. OriginData: proprio_stats.h5::state/end/position + state/end/orientation.

state.ee.description: Observed absolute left/right flange poses, each [x,y,z,qx,qy,qz,qw]. Position is meters and quaternion order is xyzw. Embodiment: A2D dexhand. OriginData: proprio_stats.h5::state/end/position + state/end/orientation.

state.ee_valid.description: Per-side [left,right] validity mask for state.ee. Invalid poses are finite zero placeholders and have mask value 0. Embodiment: A2D dexhand. OriginData: derived from proprio_stats.h5::state/end/position + state/end/orientation.

state.waist.description: Measured waist position in source order [pitch, lift]. Source-native values are preserved without normalization or unit conversion. Embodiment: A2D dexhand. OriginData: proprio_stats.h5::state/waist/position.

action/joint/position.left.description: Left-arm absolute joint-position targets in radians. Embodiment: A2D dexhand. OriginData: proprio_stats.h5::action/joint/position + action/effector/position.

action/left_effector/position.description: Left effector. Six dexterous-hand joint-position targets in radians. Embodiment: A2D dexhand. OriginData: proprio_stats.h5::action/joint/position + action/effector/position.

action/joint/position.right.description: Right-arm absolute joint-position targets in radians. Embodiment: A2D dexhand. OriginData: proprio_stats.h5::action/joint/position + action/effector/position.

action/right_effector/position.description: Right effector. Six dexterous-hand joint-position targets in radians. Embodiment: A2D dexhand. OriginData: proprio_stats.h5::action/joint/position + action/effector/position.

action.qpos.description: Commanded absolute configuration target ordered as left arm 7, left effector (six dexterous-hand joints per side), right arm 7, right effector. This is not a delta action. Embodiment: A2D dexhand. OriginData: proprio_stats.h5::action/joint/position + action/effector/position.

action.qpos_valid.description: Per-side [left,right] validity mask for action.qpos. Required joint and effector targets are finite when mask value is 1; an invalid side would be stored as finite zero placeholders with mask value 0. Embodiment: A2D dexhand. OriginData: derived from proprio_stats.h5::action/joint/position + action/effector/position.

action/end/position.description: Absolute left/right flange xyz targets in meters. Embodiment: A2D dexhand. OriginData: proprio_stats.h5::action/end/position + action/end/orientation.

action/end/orientation.description: Absolute left/right flange quaternion targets in normalized xyzw order. Embodiment: A2D dexhand. OriginData: proprio_stats.h5::action/end/position + action/end/orientation.

action.ee.description: Commanded absolute left/right flange pose targets, each [x,y,z,qx,qy,qz,qw]. Position is meters; quaternion order is xyzw. This is not a delta pose. Embodiment: A2D dexhand. OriginData: proprio_stats.h5::action/end/position + action/end/orientation.

action.ee_valid.description: Per-side [left,right] validity mask for action.ee. Invalid poses are finite zero placeholders and have mask value 0. Embodiment: A2D dexhand. OriginData: derived from proprio_stats.h5::action/end/position + action/end/orientation.

action.waist.description: Commanded absolute waist position target in source order [pitch, lift]. Source-native values are preserved without normalization or unit conversion. Embodiment: A2D dexhand. OriginData: proprio_stats.h5::action/waist/position.
